questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Andorra?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Overview” part of the Andorra article.

questions.proof: The capital is Andorra la Vella.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Andorra?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Andorra on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Andorra article.

questions.proof: Andorra, officially the Principality of Andorra, is a landlocked sovereign country located in the eastern Pyrenees Mountains of Southern Europe and bordered by Spain and France.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Andorra?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Overview” part of the Andorra article.

questions.proof: The official language is Catalan, though Spanish and French are also used.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Andorra declared war on Imperial _____ in World War I, but did not do any fighting.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Imperial”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Andorra article, under the heading “History”.

questions.proof: Andorra declared war on Imperial Germany in World War I, but did not do any fighting.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Andorra remained in a state of war against Germany until _____ as the Andorrans did not sign the Treaty of Versailles.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twentieth century.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Andorra article, under the heading “History”.

questions.proof: Andorra remained in a state of war against Germany until 1957 as the Andorrans did not sign the Treaty of Versailles.
